heading: Deferred to post-v1
text:
## Deferred to post-v1 [NDBG.24]

Items excluded from the v1 conformance requirement. Conforming v1
adapters may implement them; they may not.

**An entry here must be a scope decision, not a progress report.** A
deferral is legitimate when v1 does not have the thing to observe, or
when the obligation is already discharged by another surface and only a
convenience is deferred — and an entry claiming the second must say
which surface, so a reader can check it. "Not yet built" is not a
deferral: an unmet `must` stays a `must` and is a reportable gap
against the implementation, while an absent one is nothing at all.
